pairs.description: Chlorine accumulator keeps only the latest sample.

joi.name: E1-095
joi.script:
sum_ph := 0
sum_cl := 0
count := 0
last_hour := -1
h = (#Clock).Hour
if (h >= 10 and h <= 14 and h != last_hour) {
    sum_ph = sum_ph + (#Pool #PoolPH).Value
    sum_cl = (#Pool #PoolChlorine).Value
    count = count + 1
    last_hour = h
}
if (h == 15 and count > 0) {
    (#Report #Pool).ReportDailyQuality(sum_ph / count, sum_cl / count)
    sum_ph = 0
    sum_cl = 0
    count = 0
}

pairs.joi_note: E1 JoI v3 accumulator (depth_attempts.py) with the report selector retagged; an accumulator idiom against the IR's five snapshots.

pairs.description: Increment sample count by two, biasing both reported averages.

joi.name: E1-095
joi.script:
sum_ph := 0
sum_cl := 0
count := 0
last_hour := -1
h = (#Clock).Hour
if (h >= 10 and h <= 14 and h != last_hour) {
    sum_ph = sum_ph + (#Pool #PoolPH).Value
    sum_cl = sum_cl + (#Pool #PoolChlorine).Value
    count = count + 2
    last_hour = h
}
if (h == 15 and count > 0) {
    (#Report #Pool).ReportDailyQuality(sum_ph / count, sum_cl / count)
    sum_ph = 0
    sum_cl = 0
    count = 0
}
